title: Newly constructed  3 bedroom/2.5 Bathrooms
description:
You will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place that is minutes from Nashville.  Shopping and close access to freeways are less than 2 miles away.

The space
This is a newly constructed property is near the the heart of downtown Gallatin.  This area is close to parks and all restaurants.  Gallatin touts a rich history and it has a 60% lower crime rate than the national average.

Guest access
You can park in front of the garage or in the garage and the remote for the garage is provided.

Other things to note
Please note that you should only remove the sheets in the bed(s)you sleep on.  Make sure the garbage is placed in the garage container.
